description: Ministry of Lands - Amendment to the Land acquisition (Payment of Compensation) Regulation 2013
categorisation: This gazette contains regulations made by the Minister of Lands under the Land Acquisition Act, specifically amending the Land Acquisition (Payment of Compensation) Regulations 2013. The content focuses on legal/regulatory amendments to existing legislation rather than government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or specialized categories like land matters (which would deal with specific land transactions rather than regulatory frameworks).
